requirements.evidence: Total generation grew by 17.9% between 2015 and 2025, reaching 82.1 TWh.
requirements.reason: While the report attempts to answer with a growth percentage of 17.9%, the facts checked show this specific percentage is contradicted by the actual data value of 27.82%, though the absolute generation of 82.1 TWh is correct.
